name: garage_standard_preliminary
source: Preliminary geometry-driven meanline model. Wheel diameters match the existing GTX3582R-class hardware; internal geometry and loss coefficients are ASSUMED, not reverse-engineered or manufacturer-calibrated.

provenance.wheel_diameters: Published Garrett GTX3582R Gen II: compressor 66/82 mm and turbine 68/62 mm; https://www.garrettmotion.com/racing-and-performance/performance-catalog/turbo/gtx3582r-gen-ii/
provenance.internal_geometry: ASSUMED: 22 mm hub, 6 mm exit width, 12 effective blades, 60 degree compressor exit angle and 24 degree inlet angle; 500 mm2 effective turbine throat inherited from authored hardware
provenance.losses: ASSUMED: area blockage 0.90, passage/incidence/diffuser loss coefficients 0.20/0.60/0.40, turbine nozzle efficiency 0.95 and rotor velocity retention 0.85; slip velocity from Stodola finite-blade correlation. Transonic compressor points are explicitly unsupported.
provenance.compressor_equations: Euler work, Stodola slip velocity, ideal-gas continuity, stagnation/static energy and isentropic pressure with explicit loss work. No authored head curve. Slip reference https://www.mdpi.com/1996-1073/8/5/4317
provenance.turbine_equations: NASA Glenn compressible convergent-nozzle flow https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/k-12/BGP/mflchk.html plus preliminary impulse-rotor Euler triangle; NOT a validated radial reaction stage
